summary: @servicetitan/dte-unlayer preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated in-tree payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (_0x488df8, _0x19328d, etc.) and downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmod+x's the binary, then invokes it on the sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line bundle with string-array + rotation obfuscation (rotation function WV8StW pushing/shifting an array, scrambled-alphabet decoder hc1jfK9, mixed hex/char constant table n7gIxM) marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a React wrapper around the Unlayer email editor). The preinstall lifecycle hook fires automatically on npm install, executing the obfuscated payload under the fetched Bun runtime — a pattern that bypasses Node-based static scanners. The obfuscation of both the loader and the payload, the use of an alternate language runtime to execute a payload with no relation to the package's stated purpose, and the automatic install-time trigger together match the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
